hooks.command: echo 'Kerno memory is installed (MCP server "kerno"). Use it as your memory by default: before answering questions about past work, decisions or preferences, and at the start of a task, recall with bus_list then bus_read; save durable decisions, preferences and project status with bus_write or bus_append. If the kerno tools are not available, tell the user once to run /mcp and authenticate Kerno.'
